title: 2-Year Floating Rate Note auction (first reopening of the October new issue) — the calendar's only four-auction FRN day
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), fetched by plain curl and re-derived independently 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes), text layer decompressed stream-by-stream and re-tokenised into 213 auction records. Row reads `2-Year FRN R / Announcement Thursday, November 19, 2026 / Auction Tuesday, November 24, 2026 / Settlement Friday, November 27, 2026` — the trailing `R` marks it a REOPENING, matching the 08-20, 09-17 and 12-17 FRN rows and contrasting with the 10-22 row, which carries no `R` and is the quarterly new issue tracked as treasury-2y-frn-2026-10-28. Size $28B: sb0590's anticipated-size table alternates its FRN column 30 in new-issue months and 28 in reopening months, and the tape agrees at every reopening since 2024-05-29 (fiscaldata auctions_query, floating_rate:Yes, 154 auctions, HTTP 200, 532,321 bytes, re-pulled 2026-09-09). Stays estimate on two counts: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the confirming primary is the 2026-11-19 announcement itself. The `TSY:` confirmed prefix in market-events-data.ts covers a treasury.gov auction schedule and is deliberately NOT taken here for those two reasons.
notes: Canonical file written by this event's own never-assessed initial research (2026-09-09) after reading its single proposal, proposals/treasury-2y-frn-2026-11-24.from-treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-11-19.json, in full. THE HEADLINE, NEW TO THIS CALENDAR AND THE REASON THIS EVENT IS INTERESTING AT ALL: the 2-Year FRN's auction closing time is a SAME-DAY CONGESTION rule, not a holiday rule. Joining all 154 FRN auctions against a 4,639-row census of every Treasury auction of every tenor since 2014-01-06 (auctions_query, HTTP 200, 691,864 bytes — a join this calendar had never made), four same-day auctions produced `01:00 PM` on 12 of 12 days with no exception, while three or fewer produced 11:30 AM on 137 of 141; the count rule is right on 149 of 154 overall and 63 of 64 since 2021-06. Exceptions named rather than smoothed: 2014-04-29, 2020-12-23, 2021-01-27 and 2022-07-14 (three-auction days at 1 p.m.) and 2020-05-27 (a five-auction day at 11:30 whose slate carried two 10:00 a.m. COVID-era CMBs). This explains all eleven Thanksgiving-week FRN reopenings with ZERO exceptions — 2020, 2024 and 2025 carried four auctions and printed 1:00 p.m.; the other eight carried two or three and printed 11:30 a.m. — where a holiday-week story explains only 3 of 12. The rival 'two notes on one day push the FRN late' reading is refuted: 2014, 2015, 2016 and 2019 all put the 5-Year note on the same day at 1:00 p.m. and the FRN still closed at 11:30. THIS CORRECTS A SIBLING ON THE RECORD: treasury-2y-frn-2026-10-28.json states every one of the 16 `01:00 PM` prints falls in a holiday or short week — 2024-10-29 is an ordinary October Tuesday with four auctions (2Y, 7Y, 52-week, 42-day), and eight of the sixteen are the consecutive 2020-06 to 2021-01 COVID bill-congestion block. That ledger's 10-28 ANSWER survives, because a two-auction day is also the sparse case; its stated CAUSE does not. FORWARD CALENDAR THE RULE WRITES, from the schedule PDF's own same-day slates: 2026-09-23 three auctions -> 11:30, 2026-10-28 two -> 11:30, 2026-11-24 FOUR -> 01:00 PM, 2026-12-23 three -> 11:30, 2027-01-27 two -> 11:30. 2026-11-24 is the ONLY four-auction FRN day left in the published schedule, i.e. the single date where the congestion rule and the holiday rule make opposite predictions; 2026-12-23 is where they disagree the other way, since 2025-12-23 carried four and printed 1 p.m. SECOND MECHANICAL RESULT: the index rate is locked 2026-11-16, THREE DAYS BEFORE this event's own 2026-11-19 announcement. The rule fitted against the full 675-auction 13-week bill series (HTTP 200, 78,244 bytes) is that the index is the most recent MONDAY 13-week bill auction whose SETTLEMENT precedes the FRN's own settlement — 152 of 154, misses named (2019-01-29, shutdown-shifted bill slate; 2024-12-24, unexplained). For this date it is forced rather than inferred: Treasury's own schedule settles the Monday 2026-11-23 13-week bill on Friday 2026-11-27, the SAME day as this FRN, so that bill is excluded, and the 2026-11-16 bill (settles 11-19) is the index. The tape agrees independently — all eleven Thanksgiving-week FRN auctions carry an index date exactly 8 days out and all eleven precede their own announcement. This upgrades the 10-28 ledger's honest limit that the index date is 'modal, not published' FOR THIS DATE, and it names the trap that follows: the 13-week bill selling on Monday 2026-11-23, the day before this auction, does NOT set its index. THIRD: the Thanksgiving concession is a MEASURED NULL, the second on this week from a different security. Within-CUSIP, high discount margin minus the spread the auction's own new issue stamped runs +0.39bp at the 11 Thanksgiving-week reopenings versus +0.93bp at the other 92 (Welch t = -0.43), and +1.12bp versus +0.85bp on 2021+. This corroborates treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-11-19's independent 7-Year null (b/c 2.572 vs 2.490, n=6). The one non-null does not pay: bid-to-cover runs 3.045 vs 3.304 all-time and 2.796 vs 3.170 on 2021+ (t = -1.66) with the clearing margin unmoved — fewer bids, same price, so a composition-only read of this print manufactures a concession the price denies. FOURTH: the slot is a twelve-year institution, not an anomaly — 11 of the 12 Novembers since 2014 sold this reopening on the Tuesday two days before Thanksgiving and settled it on the Friday after, the sole exception being 2018-11-28 when Thanksgiving fell at its earliest possible date. Settlement scale measured: 2025-11-28 carried $358.8B across six securities against $274.7B for the next-largest day in the surrounding fortnight; 2026-11-27 carries five (13-week, 26-week, 6-week and 52-week bills plus this FRN) while the three note legs of the same announcement settle Monday 11-30. NO FED CHANNEL EXISTS HERE: FOMC lands 2026-10-28 and 2026-12-09, so the index date, the announcement, the auction and the settlement all fall between meetings, and the blackout opens 2026-11-28 after settlement — the decision-day story that dominates the 10-28 sibling has no analogue and is not claimed. DATA TRAP, reproduced from raw: all 12 November FRN reopenings file under security_term `1-Year 11-Month`, never `2-Year`, and a second reopening files as `1-Year 10-Month`, so a `2-Year` filter drops 46 of the 154 auctions silently. Read-it-do-not-trade-it: `symbols: []`, the date is `estimate`, and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates-keyed. Three forward tests registered in this event's own fragment, all scoring 2026-11-25: -1 the closing time reads `01:00 PM`, -2 frn_index_determination_date reads 2026-11-16, -3 the margin lands within +/-4.0bp of the spread 2026-10-28 stamps.
